mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM APPROVAL AS A JOIN USER AS U ON A.uidx = U.uidx LEFT JOIN ( SELECT bidx, coverImg, title, author, publisher FROM BOOKS ) AS B ON B.bidx = IFNULL(A.bidx, (SELECT RQ.bidx FROM REQUEST AS RQ WHERE RQ.rqidx = A.rqidx)) WHERE A.delyn = 'N'

SELECT B.coverImg, B.title, B.author, B.publisher, U.name, U.userNumber, A.aidx, A.regDate, A.status, A.rejectionReason FROM APPROVAL AS A JOIN USER AS U ON A.uidx = U.uidx LEFT JOIN ( SELECT bidx, coverImg, title, author, publisher FROM BOOKS ) AS B ON B.bidx = IFNULL(A.bidx, (SELECT RQ.bidx FROM REQUEST AS RQ WHERE RQ.rqidx = A.rqidx)) WHERE A.delyn = 'N'
ORDER BY A.aidx LIMIT #{startPageNum}, #{perPageNum};
